schema:
CREATE TABLE "tariffs" ("plan_id" INTEGER UNIQUE, "fiscal_year" INTEGER, "rate" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_id", "fiscal_year"), CHECK ("rate" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE "requests" ("plan_id" INTEGER, "fiscal_year" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_id", "fiscal_year"), FOREIGN KEY ("plan_id") REFERENCES "tariffs" ("plan_id"));
correct_query: SELECT r.plan_id, r.fiscal_year, COALESCE(t.rate, 0) AS rate FROM requests AS r LEFT JOIN tariffs AS t ON r.plan_id = t.plan_id AND r.fiscal_year = t.fiscal_year
